cli.intro: open-smt - OpenSMT placement, feeder and reflow planner (millimetres, degrees Celsius)

cmd.create: Create a new document and save it
cmd.import: Import a KiCad PCB into a new document
cmd.import-csv: Import a CSV placement table into a new document
cmd.board: Set the board outline in millimetres
cmd.panel: Set the panel rows, columns and gaps
cmd.panel-fit: Report how many boards fit inside a maximum panel size
cmd.component: Add, update or remove placed components
cmd.component-add: Add a placed component in place
cmd.component-update: Update a placed component in place
cmd.component-remove: Remove a placed component in place
cmd.feeder: Add, update, remove or report feeders
cmd.feeder-update: Update a declared feeder in place
cmd.feeder-remove: Remove a declared feeder in place
cmd.bom: Check the document against a BOM
cmd.bom-check: Report missing, extra and quantity findings against a BOM CSV
cmd.profile-set: Set conveyor speed, liquidus and zones in place
cmd.validate: Validate the document and report findings
cmd.placement: Allocate and sequence the placement program
cmd.balance: Assign components across machines and report the balance
cmd.schedule-dual: Assign tasks to two lanes by cumulative task time
cmd.schedule-lanes: Assign tasks to 2 to 16 lanes by cumulative task time
cmd.export: Export the program, feeder setup, JSON or Markdown
cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly

opt.speed: Conveyor speed in millimetres per minute
opt.strategy: Lane scheduling strategy: greedy or lpt
opt.format: Export format: program, feeders, json or md
opt.head-speed: Head speed in millimetres per second

error.unknownFormat: unknown export format `{format}`; only program, feeders, json or md is supported
error.invalidStrategy: unknown dual-lane strategy `{strategy}`; only greedy or lpt is supported
error.invalidLanes: lane count `{count}` must be an integer from 2 to 16
